invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of collectAsList(), which should always be non-null as a List implementation.
The returned list is exactly the result of collectAsList() on the tagged data, so their sizes must be equal.
The result is obtained directly from the method call, so it must be equal to that call's output.
The method expects dedupedRecords to be non-null to perform processing and create HoodieListData.
